titles.native: ごろグラごろごろ具がでっかい 篇

description:
A TV commercial animated by coalowl for Nissin Cisco's Gorugura granola.

Notes:
• The original version of the song featured in this commercial serves as the opening song in the anime Shikanoko Nokonoko Koshitantan.
• Both 30-second and 15-second versions of this commercial exist.
